lines.en: label dormwartwo5:
scene datewarfutaba1
: Hello and welcome back to yet another Dorm Wars interview with yours truly, Ayane Amamiya! Reporting in from the front of Couch Potato Arcade!
lines.zh: : 大家好，欢迎回到又一期的宿舍大战采访，还是我，Ayane Amamiya！我在「沙发土豆游戏厅」门前为您报道！

lines.en: : Folks, in just a few moments now, we’ll be going live to the middle of the entertainment district where my favorite teacher {i}and{/i} yours embarks on a date with Futaba Fukuyama that’ll go down in history!
lines.zh: : 各位，再过一小会儿，我们就将切到娱乐区中心的现场直播——我最喜欢的老师，{i}也是{/i}你们的老师，即将与 Futaba Fukuyama 开启一场必将载入史册的约会！

lines.en: : Joining me today is her self-proclaimed best friend, Nodoka Nagasawa, who’s fresh out of the hospital bed and ready to continue fighting for the girl she loves so much!
lines.zh: : 今天加入我的是她自封的挚友 Nodoka Nagasawa——她刚从病床上起来，随时准备继续为她深爱的那个女孩而战！

lines.en: : Fortunately, there was no hospital involved. But yes, I am here to tell the world of the glories of my best friend, be it self-proclaimed or not.
lines.zh: : 所幸并没有住进医院。不过没错，我今天来就是要向全世界宣告我这位挚友的光辉，无论这「挚友」是不是我自封的。

lines.en: scene datewarfutaba2
: Nodoka, our last look at the official Dorm Wars online poll brought to you by the Produce Delivery Administration has Noriko Nakayama leading by a whopping 13 points.
lines.zh: : Nodoka，我们最后一次查看由农产品配送管理局赞助的宿舍大战官方网络投票时，Noriko Nakayama 以高达 13 分的差距遥遥领先。

lines.en: : Do you worry that these early results may foreshadow the ending to this competition?
lines.zh: : 你担心这些早期的结果会预示这场比赛的结局吗？

lines.en: : Or do you believe Futaba will be able to show everyone that polls are just polls and that the real winner of every election is someone chosen by a small group of overly powerful people?
lines.zh: : 还是说，你相信 Futaba 能向所有人证明，民调不过是民调，而每一场选举真正的赢家，都是由一小撮权力过大的人挑选出来的？

lines.en: : I’m afraid I don’t have much time to spend online, so this is the first I’m hearing of any “polls.”
lines.zh: : 恐怕我没多少时间上网，所以什么「投票」我还是头一回听说。

lines.en: : But what I {i}will{/i} say is that writing off my dearest Futaba is never a good idea.
lines.zh: : 但我{i}想{/i}说的是，把我最亲爱的 Futaba 排除在外，从来都不是什么好主意。

lines.en: : What she lacks in confidence, she makes up for in both reliability and persistence. And I believe that, today, we will see a side of her we’ve seldom seen before.
lines.zh: : 她在自信上的欠缺，都用可靠和执着补了回来。而且我相信，今天我们将看到一个我们很少见过的她。

lines.en: scene datewarfutaba3
: I’d also like to add that, should any late-thirties to early-forties woman be looking for someone young and full of energy to perform heinous sex acts on them, I am always available.
lines.zh: : 我还想补充一句，如果有哪位三十七八到四十出头的女性，正在找一个年轻又精力充沛的人对她做些伤天害理的事，我随时奉陪。

lines.en: : Thanks, Nodoka. That was a completely relevant and necessary comment that I’m sure all of our viewers really appreciated.
lines.zh: : 谢了，Nodoka。这真是切题又必要的发言，我相信所有观众都非常受用。

lines.en: : Hooray for love and hooray for Team Futaba...even if siding with her gets me exiled from my floor.
lines.zh: : 爱情万岁，Futaba 队万岁……哪怕站在她这边会让我被自己楼层放逐。

lines.en: scene datewarfutaba4
: Hah...hah...hah...
: Oh! And here’s everyone’s favorite student teacher, Imani Imai, showing up almost an entire hour after the Dorm Wars began!
lines.zh: : 哦！这位是大家最喜爱的实习老师 Imani Imai，她在宿舍大战开始后将近整整一小时才姗姗来迟！

lines.en: : Imani, is there anything you have to say for yourself?
lines.zh: : Imani，你有什么要为自己辩解的吗？

lines.en: : Fell asleep...on the subway...
lines.zh: : 在地铁上……睡着了……

lines.en: : Had to run...two miles...
lines.zh: : 得跑……两英里……

lines.en: : Gonna die...
lines.zh: : 我要死了……

lines.en: : Well, better late than never! As long as you-
lines.zh: : 好吧，迟到总比不到好！只要你——

lines.en: scene datewarfutaba5
: Wait! I’ve just received word that the eagle has landed!
lines.zh: : 等等！我刚收到消息，鹰已着陆！

lines.en: scene black
: Sensei’s made contact with his first target of the night, Futaba Fukuyama! And she’s...no! It can’t be! She’s still wearing her costume?!
lines.zh: : 老师已经与今晚的第一个目标 Futaba Fukuyama 接触！而她……不！不可能！她还穿着那身装扮？！

lines.en: : A cosplay date in the big city?!
lines.zh: : 一场大城市里的角色扮演约会？！

lines.en: : Is Futaba coming out swinging despite almost always taking a more indirect approach to love?!
lines.zh: : 尽管一向在爱情上采取迂回战术，Futaba 这次是不是一上来就火力全开？！

lines.en: : Find out soon, folks! Right here on...whatever the name of our television station is!
lines.zh: : 答案即将揭晓，各位！就在……不管我们电视台叫什么名字来着！

lines.en: : We’ll be providing updates all weekend long! So make sure you tune in for our next interview with...I don’t know! Whoever we decide to interview next!
lines.zh: : 整个周末我们都将持续更新！所以请务必收看我们的下一期采访，嘉宾是……我不知道！我们下期决定采访谁就是谁！

lines.en: : So, until next time...
lines.zh: : 那么，下次再见……

lines.en: : Sayonara!
lines.zh: : 再见啦！

lines.en: scene datewarfutaba6
: Hey, sorry I’m- woah.
lines.zh: : 嘿，抱歉我——哇哦。

lines.en: scene datewarfutaba7
: Oh, Sensei! It’s fine. I wasn’t waiting very long.
lines.zh: : 哦，老师！没关系。我没等很久。

lines.en: : I take it that was a...{i}good{/i} “woah?”
lines.zh: : 看来那是个……{i}好{/i}的「哇哦」？

lines.en: : Yeah. This is just the first time I’ve gotten a good look at your costume up close and it certainly emphasizes your...uhh...
lines.zh: : 是啊。这只是我第一次近距离看清你这身装扮，它确实把你的……呃……衬托得格外突出。

lines.en: scene datewarfutaba8
: Eyes?
lines.zh: : 眼睛？

lines.en: : Yes. That is exactly what I was referring to.
lines.zh: : 对。我指的就是那个。

lines.en: : I know what you were {i}actually{/i} referring to. But it probably isn’t something we should talk about in public.
lines.zh: : 我知道你{i}实际{/i}指的是什么。不过那大概不是我们该在公共场合讨论的事。

lines.en: : To be honest, I’m surprised you’re out in public {i}at all{/i} dressed like that. I figured your...self-consciousness would be rearing its ugly head again.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我很惊讶你{i}居然{/i}穿成这样就出门了。我还以为你的……那份难为情又会冒出来作祟呢。

lines.en: scene datewarfutaba9
: Ah...yeah. I’m sure that’s what anyone would expect. And I {i}definitely{/i} haven’t been doing myself any favors in that department lately, so...
lines.zh: : 啊……是啊。我相信谁都会这么想。而且我最近在这方面{i}的确{/i}没给自己帮上什么忙，所以……

lines.en: scene datewarfutaba10
: B...But, weirdly enough, I’m actually {i}more{/i} confident being in places like this where there are tons of people rather than only having a few handfuls passing by every now and then.
lines.zh: : 不……不过，说来奇怪，待在这种人多的地方，我反而比只有零星几个人偶尔路过时{i}更{/i}有自信。

lines.en: : It’s kind of like...with so many people around, the chances of anyone looking at {i}me{/i} go way down. So I feel a little better whenever I remember that.
lines.zh: : 有点像……人越多，随便哪个人注意到{i}我{/i}的概率反而越低。所以每次想到这一点，我都会好受一些。

lines.en: : Plus there are normally a bunch of other cosplayers around here for all of the themed cafes and...yeah. I’m just trying to...blend in by...{i}not{/i} blending in?
lines.zh: : 再说这一带因为那些主题咖啡厅，平时总有一堆角色扮演的人出没，而且……嗯。我只是想……靠{i}不{/i}融入来融入？

lines.en: : Well, anyone {i}not{/i} looking at you right now is an idiot when you’re clearly the most attractive person within at least a ten block radius.
lines.zh: : 那么，眼下{i}没{/i}在看你的人都是傻子——方圆至少十个街区里，你显然是最耀眼的那一个。

lines.en: scene datewarfutaba11
: Ha! I...expected you to say something like that, but it didn’t make it any less surprising.
lines.zh: : 哈！我……就猜到你会说这种话，但真听到还是一样让人意外。

lines.en: scene datewarfutaba7
: In any case, I’m...glad you’re not put off by being out with me while I’m dressed like this.
lines.zh: : 不管怎样，我……很高兴我穿成这样出门，你也没有因此却步。

lines.en: : I felt like...if I was going to win today, I needed to challenge myself and...that meant doing something a little...unorthodox.
lines.zh: : 我觉得……如果今天想赢，我就得挑战一下自己，而……那意味着要做点……不太常规的事。

lines.en: : That determined to win, huh?
lines.zh: : 这么想赢啊？

lines.en: scene datewarfutaba12
: Failure isn’t an option today. And this costume gives me a load of extra confidence, so you better watch out.
lines.zh: : 今天不许失败。而且这身衣服给了我一大堆额外的自信，所以你最好小心点。

lines.en: scene datewarfutaba13
: I did have a sword to go along with it, but there are apparently rules against carrying things like that in public, so...I have to go pick it up from the police box later.
lines.zh: : 我本来还有一把配套的长剑，但显然公共场合不许携带那种东西，所以……我待会儿得去派出所把它领回来。

lines.en: : I leave you alone for one morning and the police come after you. I’d expect this from your competitor, but you? Futaba, come on.
lines.zh: : 我就一个早上没看着你，警察就找上门了。这种事发生在你对手身上我信，可你？Futaba，拜托。

lines.en: scene datewarfutaba10
: Let’s not talk about my competitor for now, okay? It’s just the two of us this morning and...I want it to stay that way.
lines.zh: : 我们暂时别提我那个对手了好吗？今天早上就只有我们两个人，而且……我希望一直如此。

lines.en: : Of course. So, where to next? Any plans? Or are we just going to walk around and show everyone how attractive you are for the rest of the day?
lines.zh: : 当然。那么，下一站去哪儿？有计划吗？还是说我们就在今天剩下的时间里到处逛，向所有人展示你有多迷人？

lines.en: scene sky
: I have a plan! In fact, I have several plans. And none of them involve me showing this side of myself to anyone else.
lines.zh: : 我有计划！事实上，我有好几个计划。而且没有一个涉及让除你之外的任何人看到我这一面。

lines.en: : Things like this...
lines.zh: : 像这样的……

lines.en: : Things like this are all for you. But before you respond, I want you to understand how embarrassing it was to say that and I’d prefer if you didn’t draw any attention to-
lines.zh: : 像这样的，全都是为你准备的。不过在你回答之前，我想让你明白，说出这句话有多难为情，而且我希望你别再提——

lines.en: : Say it again.
lines.zh: : 再说一遍。

lines.en: : Ugh! Sensei!
lines.zh: : 呜！老师！

lines.en: Futaba and I start walking down the streets of the entertainment district, but I don’t bother asking where we’re heading as I’m sure that I’ll figure out a way to enjoy whatever it is without any prior knowledge.
lines.zh: 我和 Futaba 沿着娱乐区的街道走起来，但我懒得问要去哪儿——我相信不管是什么，我都能在毫无准备的情况下找到乐子。

lines.en: I can’t recall any instance of the two of us going out and doing something that {i}I{/i} want to do, which I’m pretty sure is what today is about but, then again, there aren’t many things I {i}want{/i} to do to begin with.
lines.zh: 我想不起来我们俩有哪次出门是去做{i}我{/i}想做的事，而我敢说今天本该就是那样的——不过话说回来，我本来也没什么{i}想{/i}做的事。

lines.en: Just being with her is enough to make the morning worthwhile.
lines.zh: 光是和她待在一起，就足以让这个早晨变得值得。

lines.en: Especially when I can glance down at her chest any time there’s a lull in conver-
lines.zh: 尤其是每当谈话出现空档，我都能低头瞄一眼她的胸口——

lines.en: : Eyes up here, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 眼睛看这儿，老师。

lines.en: : You don’t own me.
lines.zh: : 你又不能占有我。

lines.en: : Heheh...that may be true.
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿……这倒可能是真的。

lines.en: : But for the next few hours, let’s pretend it’s not.
lines.zh: : 不过接下来的几个小时，我们就假装不是吧。

lines.en: scene black
scene datewarfutaba14
To escape the heat (And also because Futaba probably planned it) we wind up climbing a narrow staircase into a small cafe overlooking some of the less scenic parts of the entertainment district.
lines.zh: 为了避暑（也因为 Futaba 大概是计划好的），我们爬上一道狭窄的楼梯，走进一间小咖啡厅，从那里可以俯瞰娱乐区几处不太上镜的角落。

lines.en: There are no other customers, so it looks like we’ll have the place to ourselves for at least a little while.
lines.zh: 店里没有别的客人，看来至少有一小段时间，这地方会是我们俩独享的。

lines.en: This {i}would{/i} be cool, but I haven’t seen any employees yet either, so I’m beginning to question exactly what this place is and if Futaba, of all people, is going to be the one to defy all expectations and murder me.
lines.zh: 这本来挺不错，可我连一个店员都没见到，于是我开始怀疑这地方到底是什么来头，也开始怀疑 Futaba——偏偏是她——{i}会{/i}不会打破所有人的预期，把我给杀了。

lines.en: And, to be fair, I probably deserve it considering that she and Makoto seem like the two most willing to accept the fact that I am also having sex with their friends.
lines.zh: 公平地说，我大概也是罪有应得，毕竟她和 Makoto 看起来是最能接受「我也在和她们的朋友上床」这件事的两个人。

lines.en: : I regret nothing.
lines.zh: : 我一点都不后悔。

lines.en: : Hm? What’s this about regrets?
lines.zh: : 嗯？后悔什么？

lines.en: : My bad. Just talking to myself.
lines.zh: : 我的错。只是在自言自语。

lines.en: : Where’d you hear about this place anyway? I don’t recall even seeing a sign for a cafe outside.
lines.zh: : 话说你是从哪儿听说这地方的？我都不记得外面有咖啡厅的招牌。

lines.en: scene datewarfutaba15
: There used to be. I guess they either took it down or it was stolen or something.
lines.zh: : 以前有。我猜他们要么把它拆了，要么被人偷走了什么的。

lines.en: : I was actually a little worried that this place might be closed when I didn’t see anything outside, but I’m glad that worrying was for nothing.
lines.zh: : 其实在外面什么都没看到的时候，我还有点担心这地方已经关门了，不过很高兴那担心是多余的。

lines.en: : You’ve been here before, then?
lines.zh: : 那你以前来过？

lines.en: scene datewarfutaba16
: Mhm. With my parents, a {i}long{/i} time ago.
lines.zh: : 嗯。和我的父母，{i}很久{/i}以前。

lines.en: : I was a lot more into anime and manga when I was little, so they’d take me to the entertainment district to go shopping whenever they were able to find the time.
lines.zh: : 我小时候迷动漫和漫画迷得多，所以只要他们抽得出时间，就会带我来娱乐区逛街。

lines.en: : It didn’t happen often given their schedules. But any time it did, we’d come here at the end of the day and eat dessert together before heading back home.
lines.zh: : 考虑到他们的日程，这种机会并不多。但每次有，我们都会在一天结束时来这里，一起吃份甜点再回家。

lines.en: : And you’re not worried taking {i}me{/i} here will sever the...nostalgic connection you have with this place?
lines.zh: : 那你不担心带{i}我{/i}来，会斩断你和这地方之间那份……怀旧的牵绊吗？

lines.en: : It’s {i}because{/i} it’s you that I took you here. Today’s a special day too, you know? And I’m just as excited to be out with you as I was to be out with my parents back then.
lines.zh: : 正{i}因为{/i}是你，我才带你来这儿。今天也是个特别的日子，你知道吗？能和你一起出门，我就像当年和父母出门时一样兴奋。

lines.en: scene datewarfutaba15
: I just hope the management and menu haven't changed. The woman who used to run the place was always so nice to me when I was growing up.
lines.zh: : 我只希望店家和菜单都没变。以前经营这家店的那位女士，在我成长的过程中一直对我特别好。

lines.en: : And {i}I{/i} hope that anyone at all works here because, as of right now, I’m not so sure.
lines.zh: : 而{i}我{/i}只希望这里至少还有个店员在，因为就目前来看，我实在不太确定。

lines.en: : It’s not, uhh...
lines.zh: : 这不是，呃……

lines.en: : It’s not cliche...taking you to a cafe on a date, right? I’m just realizing now how...typical this must seem.
lines.zh: : 约会带你来咖啡厅，不算老套吧？我现在才意识到这看起来有多……俗套。

lines.en: : Maybe if you weren’t dressed as some sort of scantily clad warrior or something, it would be. But I’m pretty sure you could take me anywhere right now and it wouldn’t be “typical.”
lines.zh: : 如果你没穿成某种衣不蔽体的女战士之类的，也许会。但我敢肯定，现在你带我去哪儿都不算「俗套」。

lines.en: scene datewarfutaba17
: That’s fair. I got so absorbed in the moment that I kind of forgot I was even wearing this.
lines.zh: : 有道理。我太沉浸于当下，甚至有点忘了自己身上穿的是什么。

lines.en: : I promise we’ll do something more fun afterward. I just wanted to share something that was important to me with you and...I don’t get many chances to come here, so...
lines.zh: : 我保证之后我们会去做点更有趣的。我只是想和你分享对我很重要的东西，而且……我来这儿的机会不多，所以……

lines.en: : Careful. You’ve been pretty confident so far today and it would be a shame to start doubting yourself before anyone else even gets to see that.
lines.zh: : 小心点。你今天到现在都挺自信的，要是还没让别人看到就开始自我怀疑，那可太可惜了。

lines.en: scene datewarfutaba14
: You’re right. Which means this is the part where I’d normally say sorry. But I’m not going to do that today since I know you actually want to be here with me right now.
lines.zh: : 你说得对。也就是说，换作平时我这时候该说道歉了。但今天我不会——因为我知道，此刻你是真心想和我在一起的。

lines.en: : And to think that a contest is what got you to realize that and not my countless attempts at positive reinforcement through affectionate affirmation.
lines.zh: : 真没想到，让你意识到这一点的竟然是一场比赛，而不是我无数次通过深情肯定所做的正向强化。

lines.en: scene datewarfutaba18
: There are other helpful factors at play, of course. Like the fact that I’m no longer a virgin.
lines.zh: : 当然还有其他有利因素在起作用。比如我已经不是处女了。

lines.en: : Are you sure that’s a topic you want to bring up in a cafe so directly linked to a bond you have with your parents?
lines.zh: : 你确定要在一家和你与父母的牵绊如此直接相关的咖啡厅里聊这个话题吗？

lines.en: scene datewarfutaba17

: Okay, you just made stuff weird, so I’m going to use this opportunity to run to the restroom and wash my hands. But if a waitress or...anyone shows up, I’ll have a blueberry parfait and a cafe au lait.
lines.zh: : 好吧，你把气氛搞得怪怪的，那我就趁这个机会去趟洗手间洗个手。不过如果有女服务员或者……任何人来，我要一份蓝莓芭菲和一杯欧蕾咖啡。

lines.en: : Ugh. Saying those words will take away some of my masculinity points.
lines.zh: : 呃。说出这些话会扣掉我一些男子气概点数。

lines.en: : I’m sure it’ll be fine. You have plenty more to spare.
lines.zh: : 我肯定没事的。你剩下的还多着呢。

lines.en: scene datewarfutaba19
: Oh, and I’m paying today! So you can feel free to order whatever you’d like!
lines.zh: : 哦，还有今天我请客！所以你想点什么尽管点！

lines.en: : You really don’t have-
lines.zh: : 你真的不必——

lines.en: if cheater == True:
scene datewarfutaba20
WORDS HAPPEN.
lines.zh: 话语发生。

lines.en: MISS A THING.
lines.zh: 错过一件事。

lines.en: scene ayhh8
scene ayhh2
scene ayhh7
scene datewarfutaba24
else:
: Heeeeylo there! Sorry for the wait! What can I do for you?
lines.zh: : 嗨———喽！久等了！我能为您做点什么？

lines.en: scene datewarfutaba21
: Oh, hi. I’ll take- woah. You are extremely attractive and I was not prepared for that.
lines.zh: : 哦，你好。我要——哇哦。你也太好看了，我一点心理准备都没有。

lines.en: : Sorry, we’re fresh out of “You are extremely attractive and I was not prepared for that” on account of you being on a date.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，鉴于您正在约会，「你也太好看了我一点心理准备都没有」这道菜已经卖完了。

lines.en: : But if you’re looking for veal a la mode or mantis juice, I can hop back into the kitchen and start getting that ready for you.
lines.zh: : 不过如果您想要奶油小牛肉或者螳螂汁，我可以回厨房给您准备起来。

lines.en: : Uhh...how about a blueberry parfait and...a cafe au lait?
lines.zh: : 呃……那就来一份蓝莓芭菲和……一杯欧蕾咖啡？

lines.en: scene datewarfutaba22
: Yikes. By my calculations, you just incurred a net loss of roughly fifty masculinity points. May I recommend a nice hot plate of grilled weta to shove some of those points back into you?
lines.zh: : 哎呀。按我的计算，您刚刚净损失了大约五十点男子气概。要不要来一盘热腾腾的烤沙螽，好把那些点数给您补回去？

lines.en: : I have no idea what that is and it sounds weird, but sure. And to drink, I’ll have-
lines.zh: : 我不知道那是什么，而且听着怪怪的，不过行吧。至于喝的，我要——

lines.en: scene datewarfutaba23
: Goat urine?!
lines.zh: : 山羊尿？！

lines.en: : What? No. That’s-
lines.zh: : 什么？不是。那是——

lines.en: : Sorry. All orders are non-refundable. Now, if you could please close your eyes, I can start preparing your meal.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。所有订单概不退换。现在，请您闭上眼睛，我好开始准备您的餐点。

lines.en: : Why do you need me to close my eyes? What kind of cafe even is this? Why are there no signs? Why is the only employee I’ve encountered peddling piss? Why is-
lines.zh: : 你为什么需要我闭上眼睛？这到底算什么咖啡厅？为什么一块招牌都没有？为什么我唯一遇见的店员在兜售尿液？为什么——

lines.en: : Not everything has an answer, you know! And not everything has to! So it’s probably best to just never ask questions at all and accept everything you’re given!
lines.zh: : 不是每件事都有答案的，你知道吗！也不是每件事都得有！所以最好的办法就是永远别提问，别人给你什么你就收下什么！

lines.en: : And if it sounds like I’m saying that reluctantly, I’m not! Please! Just do what you’re told!
lines.zh: : 就算听起来我像是在不情愿地说这些，我也不是！求你了！叫你做什么就做什么吧！

lines.en: : Now close your gosh darn eyes before I sew them shut.
lines.zh: : 趁我还没把你的眼睛缝上，赶紧给我闭上。

lines.en: scene black
: Fine. But only because-
lines.zh: : 好吧。但只是因为——

lines.en: : Sensei?
lines.zh: : 老师？

lines.en: scene datewarfutaba24
: Huh?
: Were you up late? You just nodded off out of nowhere.
lines.zh: : 你昨晚熬夜了吗？你刚刚毫无预兆地就打起瞌睡来了。

lines.en: : I’m not boring you, am I? Because the main objective of today is for you to have fun and-
lines.zh: : 我没有让你觉得无聊吧？因为今天的主要目标是让你开心，而且——

lines.en: : Oh, no. I’m fine.
lines.zh: : 哦，没有。我没事。

lines.en: : Probably just exhausted from all of the walking or something.
lines.zh: : 大概只是走太多路累着了什么的。

lines.en: scene datewarfutaba25
: Well, I hate to be the bearer of bad news, but we’ve got a lot more walking to do after this.
lines.zh: : 唉，我不想当那个报坏消息的人，不过这之后我们还有好多路要走呢。

lines.en: : I’ve got you for another three hours before your date with Noriko begins, and I plan on using every second.
lines.zh: : 在你和 Noriko 的约会开始之前，你还有三个小时属于我，而我打算一秒都不浪费。

lines.en: scene black
The next two and a half hours go by without me ever falling asleep again.
lines.zh: 接下来的两个半小时里，我再也没有睡着过。

lines.en: We move all over the entertainment district, visiting a variety of locations Futaba handpicked to make sure I enjoy every minute of the date.
lines.zh: 我们在娱乐区各处穿梭，造访了一个又一个 Futaba 精心挑选的地点，只为确保我享受约会的每一分钟。

lines.en: One of those locations was a love hotel- in which we had sex three times, costume and all. So it’s clear to see just how tailor-made this date was to fit my interests.
lines.zh: 其中一处是爱情旅馆——我们在那里做了三次，连装扮都没脱。由此可见这场约会是为迎合我的喜好量身定做的。

lines.en: scene datewarfutaba26
But now, we’ve got half an hour left before the date comes to a close and nothing to spend it on.
lines.zh: 但现在，约会结束前只剩半个小时，我们却没什么可打发的了。

lines.en: And with me being very bad when it comes to suggesting...well, anything, I go ahead and shoot off the only thing I can think of to pass the rest of that time.
lines.zh: 而我非常不擅长提议……任何事，于是我干脆脱口说出了唯一能想到的、用来消磨剩下时间的主意。

lines.en: : Love hotel round two?
lines.zh: : 爱情旅馆第二轮？

lines.en: : Sure. But only if you’re okay with me being paralyzed for life as my lower body can not handle anymore of you.
lines.zh: : 好啊。不过前提是你能接受我下半辈子瘫痪——我的下半身再也承受不住你了。

lines.en: scene datewarfutaba27
: Maybe not, then. Even if the rest of the date was great, I think ending it in a hospital would lead to {i}that{/i} being the only part of it I remember.
lines.zh: : 那还是算了。就算约会其余部分都很棒，我想如果最后进了医院，{i}那{/i}大概会是我唯一记得的部分。

lines.en: : Well...the only other idea I have is all about me. And I wouldn’t want to subject you to coming along with me to another bookstore when-
lines.zh: : 嗯……我唯一剩下的点子都是关于我自己的。而且我也不想硬拉着你陪我去又一家书店，毕竟——

lines.en: : Sure. Let’s do that.
lines.zh: : 好啊。就去吧。

lines.en: scene datewarfutaba28
: Sensei, you don’t have to humor me. I know you don’t normally have {i}fun{/i} in places like that. And having such an anticlimactic end to one of the best days in a long time would be-
lines.zh: : 老师，你不用迁就我。我知道你平时在那类地方并不{i}开心{/i}。而且让这么久以来最棒的一天之一落得这么扫兴的结尾，会——

lines.en: : Not anticlimactic at all. The idea of a date where only one person enjoys themselves is intrinsically flawed  when the whole idea of things like this is for {i}both{/i} people to have fun.
lines.zh: : 一点也不扫兴。约会的本意就是让{i}两个{/i}人都开心，所以「只有一个人尽兴的约会」这个念头本身就站不住脚。

lines.en: : So go ahead and lead me toward the books and I will do my best to not talk about how bored I will be.
lines.zh: : 所以，带我奔向那些书吧，我会尽量不说自己有多无聊。

lines.en: : I mean...you kind of just did. But...if there’s really nothing else you can think of...I do remember where the store is located. And it’s not that far from here.
lines.zh: : 我是说……你刚刚已经说了。不过……如果你真的想不出别的……我还记得那家店在哪儿。而且离这儿不远。

lines.en: : But are you sure you’re okay with-
lines.zh: : 可是你真的没问题吗——

lines.en: : Stop trying to talk me out of this and just run to your precious books already.
lines.zh: : 别再劝我打退堂鼓了，快奔向你那些宝贝书去吧。

lines.en: : Sensei-
lines.zh: : 老师——

lines.en: : I’m serious. Go. Be free.
lines.zh: : 我是认真的。去吧。自由去吧。

lines.en: : No, I-
: As free as the wind blows.
lines.zh: : 像风一样自由。

lines.en: scene datewarfutaba29
: I’m trying to tell you I can’t run! You were too mean to my vagina and it’s taking all I have to even walk!
lines.zh: : 我是想告诉你我跑不了！你对我的阴道太狠了，我现在光是走路都得拼尽全力！

lines.en: : Oh.
: I get it now.
lines.zh: : 我明白了。

lines.en: scene datewarfutaba30
: Nice.
lines.zh: : 厉害。

lines.en: : I do what I can.
lines.zh: : 我只是做了我能做的。

lines.en: : Oh God...I forgot there were other people around...
lines.zh: : 天哪……我都忘了周围还有别人……

lines.en: : Hey, wait a second. How old is-
lines.zh: : 嘿，等一下。你多大——

lines.en: scene black
: Futaba, run.
lines.zh: : Futaba，快跑。

lines.en: : I just told you I can’t!
lines.zh: : 我刚说了我不行啊！

lines.en: scene datewarfutaba31
: Hah...this is really not how I thought today was going to end. And after the rest of it went so well...
lines.zh: : 哈……今天真不是我想象中的收尾方式。在前面一切都很顺利之后……

lines.en: : This place looks familiar.
lines.zh: : 这地方看着眼熟。

lines.en: scene datewarfutaba32
: It’s a new branch of that other bookstore I’ve dragged you to before. And if what I’ve heard is true, their romance section is twice as large.
lines.zh: : 这是我以前拖你去过的那家书店的新分店。而且如果我没听错的话，这里的言情区是那边的两倍大。

lines.en: : Just think of how many elves you’ll be able to fuck.
lines.zh: : 想想看，你能上多少精灵啊。

lines.en: scene datewarfutaba33
: I bet an elf would be gentler with my body than you are.
lines.zh: : 我打赌精灵会比你温柔得多。

lines.en: : Wow. That was a low blow. I’m really self-conscious about how great I am at sex, you know. Finding a girl who can handle that is-
lines.zh: : 哇。这招真够狠的。你知道的，我对自己在床上有多厉害这件事其实很没自信。能找到一个扛得住的姑娘可——

lines.en: : You two need to leave.
lines.zh: : 你们两个得走了。

lines.en: scene datewarfutaba34
: What?! But we haven’t even gotten to read more book yet! I have to read more book! More book is...wait, why is it spelled like that?
lines.zh: : 什么？！可我们还没读更多的书呢！我得读更多的书！更多的书是……等等，为什么它拼成那样？

lines.en: : Let’s just go, Futaba. It’s clear we’re not needed here.
lines.zh: : 我们走吧，Futaba。显然这儿不需要我们。

lines.en: scene black
: But...my elves!
lines.zh: : 可是……我的精灵们！

lines.en: : Hah...I should have just sold tacos like my cousin.
lines.zh: : 哈……我当初就该像我表哥那样去卖塔可的。

lines.en: And so our date comes to an end with the two of us getting kicked out of a bookstore.
lines.zh: 就这样，我们的约会以两个人被赶出书店而告终。

lines.en: But not before stopping at one more love hotel and paralyzing Futaba for life.
lines.zh: 不过在那之前，我们还顺路去了另一家爱情旅馆，并把 Futaba 弄成了终身瘫痪。
